headline: SK Hynix shares tank as exponential earnings growth fails to satisfy AI-charged expectations
detail: This headline confirms the chip sector is under significant pressure, with even strong earnings not enough to meet high AI expectations. This directly impacts your SMH and SOXL holdings.
rec: Consider trimming SOXL. Its leveraged nature and current -56.96% loss make it highly vulnerable in a chip rout.

headline: Minister apologizes as Korean leveraged ETF investors nurse heavy losses amid chip stock rout
